about: Ground truth for the builder pages, written by the builder from each page's design before any walker or model judged them. status 'failure' carries a barrier; 'clean' is a control whose behaviour is correct. w1_design is the design intent for W1 on a failure ('should-catch' or 'should-miss'), null on a clean control. carrier_ids are DOM ids of the elements that carry the barrier or the behaviour under test.

pages.barrier: Enter makes the already-rendered sign-in dialog opaque (opacity 0 to 1) but focus stays on the Sign in button behind the scrim.
Correct: Enter opens the modal dialog with focus on its first field; Escape closes it and returns focus to Edit address.
Enter shows the Invite people modal dialog but focus stays on the button behind it.
Correct: Enter shows each answer below its question and focus stays on the question button, as a disclosure should.
Enter slides the already-rendered, off-screen menu drawer in with a transform but focus stays on the Menu button behind the scrim.
Correct: Enter opens the Sort menu with focus on its first item; Escape closes it and returns focus to Sort.
Enter opens the Actions menu but focus stays on the button instead of moving to the first item.
Shipping and billing addresses are drawn as two columns but Tab alternates between them row by row, never up.
pages.transition: Tab from #ship-name to #bill-name, then every step between the two columns

pages.barrier: Correct: a modal filter panel open on load keeps Tab inside it (Close filters, the brand checkboxes, capacity, Reset, Apply), skipping the visible but inert shop behind; Escape or Close filters closes it, removes inert and returns focus to Filters, which reopens it with focus on the first checkbox.
pages.transition: Every Tab inside #filters, from #brand-ridge on load; Escape in #filters and Enter then Escape on #filters-open

pages.barrier: Footer links sit in three headed columns but Tab reads across the columns row by row, never up.
pages.transition: Tab from #tour to #about, then every step across the columns

pages.barrier: Correct: an A to Z glossary flows down three newspaper columns and Tab moves up to the top of each next column.
Password is in the Tab order before Email although Email is drawn above it, so Tab moves up from Password to Email.

Three plan cards, each with a seats field and a Choose button, are drawn side by side but Tab goes from Basic seats to Pro seats and Team seats before Choose Basic, breaking the task inside each card, never up.
pages.transition: Tab from #seats-basic to #seats-pro, and from #seats-team down to #choose-basic

pages.barrier: Correct: a right-to-left Hebrew page, so Tab moves leftwards along each row.
Correct: Tab finishes the Account column, then moves up to the top of the Notifications column.
Correct: the article is read before the right sidebar, so Tab moves up from the article's last link to the sidebar's first field.
The toolbar reads Bold, Italic, Underline, Link left to right but Tab visits it right to left (row-reverse).
Enter opens the reply box (no dialog semantics) but a toolbar re-render moves focus to the search field at the top, outside the box; the field looks unchanged but is a new node.
The card widget wraps Tab among card number, expiry and security code; Escape does nothing, so Pay and the footer are unreachable.
pages.transition: Tab from #card-cvc back to #card-number; Escape inside #card-widget

pages.barrier: Correct: Tab inserts spaces in the code editor, but Escape then Tab leaves it, as the visible hint says.
pages.transition: Tab inside #code; Escape then Tab to #save-snippet
